LESSON: THANKFULNESS BY THE END OF THE SUB STRAND

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: By the end of the Sub strand, the ● Learners to read the story of Ananias and Sa
Topic 4.2: Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain what Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand means in simple pupil language
2. give 3 correct examples of Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand from Kenya
3. practise Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand in clear steps
4. apply Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand in one real-life situation this week

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: THANKFULNESS BY THE END OF THE SUB STRAND
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 3
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: THANKFULNESS BY THE END OF THE SUB STRAND
Study Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Explain what Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand means in simple pupil language

What this means
In this part you learn to explain what Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand means in simple pupil language. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain what Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand means in simple pupil language.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain what Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand means in simple pupil language. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Give 3 correct examples of Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand from Kenya

What this means
In this part you learn to give 3 correct examples of Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand from Kenya. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: give 3 correct examples of Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand from Kenya.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can give 3 correct examples of Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand from Kenya. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Practise Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand in clear steps

What this means
In this part you learn to practise Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand in clear steps. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: practise Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand in clear steps.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can practise Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand in clear steps. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Apply Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand in one real-life situation this week

What this means
In this part you learn to apply Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand in one real-life situation this week. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: apply Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand in one real-life situation this week.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand in one real-life situation this week. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: explain what Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand means in simple pupil language)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand in your own words. (skill: give 3 correct examples of Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand from Kenya)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: practise Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand in clear steps)

Example 4: Show how “Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: apply Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand in one real-life situation this week)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain what Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand means in simple pupil language.
3. Practise this skill: give 3 correct examples of Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand from Kenya.
4. Practise this skill: practise Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand in clear steps.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 3 learner study Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain what Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand means in simple pupil language.
5. Be able to: give 3 correct examples of Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand from Kenya.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
